verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.27 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2022 (90% interval −0.39 to −0.01). Of 60 untouched cells given the same test, 1 showed a divergence this large (placebo p = 0.03).
